raw:
I remember a boy at the fair who’d lost his tickets. His pocket was empty, and there was a torn seam in it. That’s the bit I remember most—the seam. You could see how he could have lost them without realizing, and then he had nothing to use for the rides.

I felt sorry for him. Something like that might seem small to somebody else, but when you’re the one it’s happened to, it isn’t small. And at a fair, the tickets are what let you join in, aren’t they? Everything is right there, but you can’t do much without them.

I gave him two of my ride coupons. It wasn’t replacing everything he’d lost, but it was something I could do right then. I didn’t want him to miss out just because his pocket had come apart.
